name: Can crown molding be installed on vaulted or sloped ceilings?

mainEntity.name: Can crown molding be installed on vaulted or sloped ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crown molding can definitely be installed on angled or vaulted ceilings, but it requires specialized transition techniques. Because standard crown assumes a 90-degree intersection between wall and ceiling, angled ceilings demand custom transition blocks, compound miter cuts, or horizontal returns. Another option is running a flat frieze board below the ceiling plane to create a uniform level surface for the crown profile. Planning these corner details in advance determines whether the final look appears seamless or awkward.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but vaulted ceilings require specialized compound miter cuts, corner transition blocks, or flat frieze boards to resolve non-standard angles cleanly.
